title: Nothing to Mark
description: Clicking "mark all as read" with an empty or already-clean inbox shouldn't error — it should just report that nothing needed doing.
successCondition: POST /api/notifications/read-all, called by a freshly registered account with no notifications at all, returns 200 with marked equal to 0. Calling it again immediately after returns 200 with marked equal to 0 as well.
hints: marked reflects how many rows the updateMany call actually touched — 0 is a perfectly valid, successful response here, not an error.
Use a brand-new account so you can be confident there are exactly zero unread notifications to begin with.
